models.RideInput: The form state representing everything the user enters about their planned ride — location, dates, bike type, intensity, and optional distance/elevation.
models.DayStop: An overnight stop for multi-day tours, including location and optional planned km for that day.
models.LocationSuggestion: An autocomplete suggestion returned when the user types an address, including display text and coordinates.
models.BikeTypeOption: One of four selectable bike types (Road bike, Gravel, MTB, City) with label, description, and icon.
models.RidingIntensityOption: One of three selectable intensity levels (Relaxed, Moderate, Sporty) with label and description.
models.QuickPreset: A pre-filled ride example shown as a shortcut so users can get started without typing every field.

relationships: RideInput contains a selected LocationSuggestion once the user picks an address
RideInput has a bikeType field matching one of the BikeTypeOption values
RideInput has an intensity field matching one of the RidingIntensityOption values
RideInput contains DayStops for multi-day tours
QuickPresets can pre-populate a RideInput to speed up form entry
